_about: Standard GT2 pulley pairs (ADR-063). Each pair is one discrete choice. Pitch diameters are computed (teeth x pitch / pi) and must not be written here: an entry with a pitch diameter is rejected. Masses are required fields still to be entered (null = not entered, counted as 0 g and listed as missing).
